profile.name: Thorlabs APT通信端口
profile.description: 用于Thorlabs APT位移台/控制器通信的非物理软件组件。它负责通过串口样式端口发送和接收消息、运行消息处理循环、提供文件描述符访问，并读取控制器序列号、通道数量及已连接平台信息，适合在实验自动化中管理单控制器或卡槽式控制器的通信连接。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for communicating with Thorlabs APT motion-stage controllers. It sends and receives protocol messages over a serial-style port, runs the message-processing loop, exposes the file descriptor, and retrieves controller serial number, channel count, and connected stage information for automation workflows involving single-controller or card-slot controllers.

registry.name: Communication Port
registry.description: 通用设备通信端口接口，支持串口、TCP等多种底层传输协议。
